note: Self-test anchor set for tools/banking/report.py. Integration replaces this with banking_systems.json from the banking-anchors branch; both must use this schema (README.md). Sources are already-in-repo references: tests/fixtures/anchors/kick.json and TP B.28 as recorded in docs/research/gap-k66-cushion-params.md sec 3.

anchors.provenance: Spec SC-002 / Dr. Dave bank-kick effects FAQ via tests/fixtures/anchors/kick.json: 1/3, 2/3, 3/3 of maximum sidespin produce approximately 1, 2, 3 diamonds of cross-table change on a lengthwise kick (cue_v0 2 m/s, full english tip offset 0.5).

Regression pins from tests/fixtures/anchors/kick.json measured_diamonds (Han 2005 and Stronge identical to < 1e-4 diamonds; gross-slip Coulomb cap). Fitted Mathavan presets are EXPECTED to deviate from these pins -- their friction/restitution differ by design; judge them against the SC-002 spec anchor above.

Dr. Dave TP B.28 (2023-08, drdavepoolinfo.com/technical_proofs/new/TP_B-28.pdf; digitized in docs/research/gap-k66-cushion-params.md sec 3): sliding banks, through-diamond point on the opposite rail (meas) per diamond aim point on the banking rail (aim). 9-ft Olhaussen -- Dr. Dave's video table, banks 'on system'. Harness reading: center-line simplification (measure.py measure_tp_b28), a documented approximation of the through-diamond optics; tolerances are wide accordingly.
